realizes.rationale: The existing role_message registration declares body/attach and waiting-message inputs and delegates to the role-message payload owner without adding a public tool. Its documented output promises are not universal producer/DTO completeness proof: held turnId is absent from RoleMessageResponse, and held filing/wait gaps remain Owner/Worker-owned.
The public structural role tool advertises model/effort/tier and the allowed feature surface without a permission-mode start parameter.
